AIR 960 (legacy candidate feed).caveat: Legacy feed name only; its identity and relationship to a current Utah 960 AM broadcast were not established. Keep separate from verified ESPN sources.

FOX 13 Utah (TV; supplementary).caveat: Television audio supplement, not FM or AM radio. Channel 13 is the viewer-facing TV channel.

N7QXB public receiver probe (station unv.caveat: Requested receiver setting does not establish the frequency or station actually heard. No reliable station identification was recovered.

ESPN The Fan / KOVO / KUDD-HD2.location_label: Utah County; 98.3 FM Salt Lake City relay
ESPN The Fan / KOVO / KUDD-HD2.caveat: FCC relay K252DI lists KUDD as primary; recorded legal ID identifies KUDD-HD2 and ESPN The Fan. Internet, podcast and studio-video sources may have different breaks.

KVNU.location_label: Logan / Cache Valley; northern Utah and southern Idaho
KVNU.caveat: Current broadcaster page confirms 610 AM and 102.1 FM. An older KVNU article mentioned Tremonton 98.3, but the current FCC record assigns that relay to KVFX; 98.3 is not labeled as current KVNU coverage.

KARB.caveat: Official schedule also lists 106.7 Emery, 101.1 Green River and 94.3 Moab. Public stream and HTTP backup carry the same station service; exact FM/web ad equivalence is unverified.

KKUT / The Wolf.location_label: Mount Pleasant / Utah and Wasatch counties; Provo 98.3 relay
KKUT / The Wolf.caveat: FCC K252DB is the licensed Provo 98.3 relay of KKUT. This is KKUT 93.7, distinct from KWUT 97.7. Relay-local and online insertions are unverified.

KARB / KKUT mixed supplement.location_label: Price and Utah/Wasatch counties; varies by source audio
KARB / KKUT mixed supplement.caveat: Contains separate KARB and KKUT items. Use each original audio path to identify its station; do not treat the combined file as one broadcast.

KPCW.location_label: Park City / Summit and Wasatch counties
KPCW.caveat: Official service also lists 88.1 and 91.9 FM. KPCW is distinct from the Park City 98.3 K-LOVE relay. Online audio and RF timing may differ.

KVFX / Utah's VFX.caveat: FCC K252EL currently identifies KVFX as primary. This current assignment supersedes an older KVNU article associating 98.3 with KVNU.

Fuzion California (St. George counterpar.location_label: California online feed; possible K219LJ St. George counterpart
Fuzion California (St. George counterpar.caveat: Utah 91.7 is officially Fuzion; FCC lists KODV Barstow as translator primary. California is the best primary-station match, but the exact St. George online counterpart and local inserts remain unverified.

Fuzion Las Vegas (St. George counterpart.location_label: Las Vegas online feed; St. George counterpart unverified
Fuzion Las Vegas (St. George counterpart.caveat: Separate official regional stream retained for uncertainty coverage. No primary source establishes it as the exact St. George K219LJ feed; FCC lists KODV Barstow as primary.

Key Radio / KEYR / KEYV.caveat: One official Key Radio network stream represents these two stations. Stream identifies as Key Radio - KEYY; exact local IDs and insertions for KEYR/KEYV are unverified.

K-LOVE (online player sample; Utah relay.location_label: Network player sample; Utah relay K252EH / KNKL
K-LOVE (online player sample; Utah relay.caveat: Park City relay is assigned to KNKL/K-LOVE, but this sample was not verified as a Utah-local feed. Ordinary player showed a Texas location.

K-LOVE network (Utah local inserts unver.location_label: Network online feed; Utah relay K252EH / KNKL
K-LOVE network (Utah local inserts unver.caveat: Park City primary is KNKL/K-LOVE, 88.1 FM Logan/Tremonton. Monitored online player selected Texas; Utah-local announcements, insertions and exact RF equivalence are unverified.

KNRS.caveat: Official KNRS-FM online service. Any 570 AM simulcast status was not freshly verified and is not included in this label.

KOHS.caveat: Officially linked online player; exact over-air and internet content equivalence is unverified.

KSL NewsRadio (official studio feed).caveat: Recorded source is the official in-studio live video feed. Its audio may omit or differ from terrestrial radio commercial breaks.

KUER.location_label: Salt Lake City; statewide network; Moab K219KR
KUER.caveat: Recorded main KUER HD1 public stream. FCC identifies KUER-FM as primary for licensed Moab 91.7 translator; translator-local inserts and RF timing unverified.

KUFR / Family Radio.caveat: Station-specific KUFR player verified; exact online and terrestrial local inserts are unverified.

Utah Public Radio.caveat: Recorded UPR Live/HD1 feed. Official full-power affiliates also include 88.5 Vernal, 89.3 Richfield, 88.7 Moab and 89.7 Price; translators use additional frequencies. Network affiliation does not establish identical local inserts.
